title: Experiential / players on the gradient

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Judge a large color field with real people in it so the palette’s impact is visible in use.
strategic_value: The warm-to-purple field can make an Instagram activation identifiable even when no logo appears in the crop.
demonstration: Two players and a ball occupy a court that transitions from orange through pink to purple.
practical_value: Use a logo-free action crop to test how much identity the environmental palette carries.

content_islands.name: Gradient playing field
content_islands.spec: Let the continuous color transition fill the photograph.

content_islands.name: Players and shadows
content_islands.spec: Retain the two players, ball and shadows as scale and activity cues.

reference_purposes.Expression: The cropped scene shows the gradient carrying the visual character without a visible logo.
reference_purposes.Application: The color field is demonstrated beneath real sporting activity.
